reserveReview.rationale: Current-source re-measurement at 2026-08-20T14:11:41Z (Linea block 31772905) and 2026-08-20T14:12:07Z (Polygon block 92353400), using the documented supported-collateral registries and live VaultFactory.collateral(token) plus TokenToPriceFeed.tokenPrice(token) reads. Positive balances were normalized to EUR value across both current factories: Linea meUSDC 69.22111659%, WETH 13.77718457%, WBTC 9.24997653%, meUSDT 3.72753249%, mewETH 2.34960213%, USDC.e 0.93407760%, wstETH 0.50893438%, USDT 0.10890668%, mewstETH 0.06199678%, and DAI 0.01618459%; Polygon USDC.e is 0.04448766%. The current positive collateral total is approximately EUR 21,099.24; supported tokens with zero balance are omitted. meUSDC.underlying() resolves to Circle's official Linea USDC contract 0x176211869ca2b568f2a7d4ee941e073a821ee1ff and meUSDT.underlying() to Linea USDT 0xa219439258ca9da29e9cc4ce5596924745e12b93. No material supported balance is unenumerated.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: 3A supported-collateral registries plus live VaultFactory collateral balances valued by TokenToPriceFeed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The source registries expose the complete supported token set used in the current factories; zero-balance supported tokens are omitted and no material positive balance was omitted.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The live balances are held in 3A VaultFactory-linked smart contracts on Polygon and Linea rather than with a conventional custodian. The reviewed contract/documentation surfaces do not establish legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation terms; contract integrity and governance are the operative custody failure domains.
